hints.title: Count Character Parity
hints.text: The counts of zeros and ones cannot differ by more than 1 for an alternating string to exist.

hints.title: Evaluate Alternating Patterns
hints.text: Test both alternating targets starting with 0 and starting with 1 when allowed by character counts.

hints.title: Mismatch Swap Equivalence
hints.text: Each swap resolves two misplaced characters; the required swaps equal mismatches divided by 2.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is length of string s
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Breadth search over all swap states leads to exponential search spaces.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Counting mismatches against fixed alternating patterns runs in O(n) time and O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks parity count validity before calculating mismatches / 2.
